purpose: Defines the thermal activation energy ΔG for dislocation slip as a function of the resolved shear stress, using a modified Kocks-type glide resistance (obstacle) profile.
applicability_conditions: Applies to thermally activated dislocation glide over obstacles described by a modified glide resistance profile introduced by Kocks et al.; this obstacle model is also used to capture the effect of the j-carbides.

symbols.meaning: activation energy for slip (thermal activation energy required to overcome the obstacle)
total free energy required to overcome an obstacle without the aid of external work
obstacle strength / mechanical threshold stress (athermal stress required to overcome the obstacle); when Eq. 8 is inserted into Eq. 6 it is expressed as τ_0 + αGb√ρ_x (see Eq. 9)
